verdict.rationale: A mobile GitHub client could plausibly offer hardware-backed, biometric-protected SSH key storage, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents PR review, notifications, Copilot agent tasks and code search, with no mention of SSH keys, secure enclave storage or biometric protection. A community comment notes the app is not really a git client.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can store my SSH keys in a hardware-backed secure enclave protected by biometrics
